description: This file defines an Android AccessibilityService named SampleInputMethodAccessibilityService that demonstrates usage of Input Method Editor (IME) APIs. It includes inner classes, button controls for testing IME features, and overlays for monitoring events.

classes.name: SampleInputMethodAccessibilityService
classes.description: Main class extending AccessibilityService to provide IME testing UI and event monitoring.

classes.name: InputMethodImpl
classes.description: Inner class extending InputMethod, implements callbacks related to input events.

classes.name: EventMonitor
classes.description: Referenced but not fully shown; used for monitoring accessibility events.

methods.name: onServiceConnected
methods.description: Initializes overlays and UI components when the service is connected.

methods.name: onCreateInputMethod
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of the custom InputMethod implementation.

methods.name: onAccessibilityEvent
methods.description: Overridden but empty; receives accessibility events.

methods.name: onInterrupt
methods.description: Overridden but empty; handle interrupting the service.

methods.name: addButtons
methods.description: Helper method to add a set of buttons to a layout for triggering IME actions.
